first_step.body: You didn't wait to feel ready; you took the first step. The path is yours now.

route_drawn.body: You did more than think about where to go; you drew yourself a route forward.

dream_space_created.body: You made room in your life for the dream in your mind. Now you have a direction to return to.

rhythm_found.body: For seven days, you kept coming back for yourself. This is more than one day now; it's your rhythm.

rhythm_kept.body: You stayed with your path for thirty days. The rhythm you built is now a strong part of you.

returned_to_path.body: A pause didn't end your journey. Today, you returned to yourself right where you left off.

route_renewed.body: Instead of clinging to the plan, you renewed it around what you need. That's how you own your path.

starting_point_set.body: You recorded your first mock exam. Now you'll be able to see how far you travel.

mistake_revisited.body: You returned to a mistake and looked again. Sometimes, that's exactly where learning deepens.

week_reflected.body: You paused to hear what your week was telling you. Your next step is a little clearer now.

first_hello.eyebrow: You left your first mark here
first_hello.body: You shared your first words with the community. You no longer have to walk this path alone.

helped_someone.body: Something you shared helped another learner. Sometimes a little support carries us a long way.
